site.name: lattice
site.summary: lattice-clone Fictional hosted columnar / relational database "Lattice DB" marketing site, centered on the two-dimensional matrix on the pricing page. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Short landing: technical paragraph + SQL code example + 3 features + CTA | | `pricing.html` | Main page: 6 rows (seats) × 6 columns (data volume) two-dimensional matrix; clicking a cell highlights the row and column and updates the right-side sticky quote card (with a "How this is calculated" expansion); 9 add-on checkboxes (percentage or flat add-on); bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card; 4-tier explainer (clicking a cell auto-highlights the corresponding tier); 15-row feature comparison; 8-question FAQ; footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #6D28D9 purple; IBM Plex Sans + Mono; responsive |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the lattice system, focusing on the pricing flow, adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths, with exhaustive coverage of all known pages and features in both viewport modes.
run_plan.summary: Start with the index.html landing page to validate its content and CTA. Then move to the pricing.html page to explore the matrix interaction, add-ons, tier details, and other sections. Repeat critical checks in mobile viewport. Ensure all pages, features, and states are covered within the step limit.
assumptions: The site has two main pages (index and pricing) with responsive design.
The pricing page has a matrix with interactive cells, add-ons, and sticky quote card.
All links and controls are functional as per prescan.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html matrix cells (interaction and state updates)
small tap targets on navigation links (mobile usability)

phases.title: Landing Page Exploration
phases.objective: Validate index.html content, interactables, and responsive layout.
key_checks: Check all navigation links (Platform, Pricing, Docs, etc.) for responsiveness
Check feature cards (Postgres wire, Columnar under the hood, etc.) for content and layout
Test mobile viewport for small tap targets and responsive design
exit_criteria: All index.html interactables tested, responsive layout validated, and CTA functionality confirmed

phases.title: Pricing Page Initial Exploration
phases.objective: Explore the pricing matrix, cell interaction, and initial quote card updates.
key_checks: Click multiple matrix cells (e.g., $89, $304, $160) to test row/column highlighting and quote card updates
Validate 'How this is calculated' expansion functionality
Check tier explainer (Developer, Team, etc.) for cell highlighting and tier details
Test mobile viewport for matrix interaction and quote card responsiveness
exit_criteria: Matrix cell interaction validated, quote card updates confirmed, and tier explainer functionality tested

phases.title: Add-ons and Final Breakdown
phases.objective: Test add-on checkboxes (percentage/flat) and final monthly-fee breakdown.
key_checks: Toggle add-on checkboxes (e.g., Continuous cross-region backups, HIPAA compliance pack) to test percentage/flat calculation updates
Validate final monthly-fee breakdown card for accuracy
Check add-on recovery paths (unchecking add-ons) for correct calculation updates
Test mobile viewport for add-on interaction and breakdown responsiveness
exit_criteria: Add-on functionality validated, final breakdown accuracy confirmed, and recovery paths tested

phases.title: Pricing Page Exhaustive Exploration
phases.objective: Explore remaining sections (feature matrix, FAQ, footer) and validate all interactables.
key_checks: Explore feature matrix (15-row comparison) for content and layout
Test FAQ accordions (if present) for expansion/collapse functionality
Test mobile viewport for remaining sections and interactables
exit_criteria: All pricing.html sections explored, interactables tested, and mobile responsiveness validated

coverage_targets.pages: visit and test all known HTML pages (index.html, pricing.html)
coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible controls (navigation links, CTA, matrix cells, add-ons, tier explainer, feature matrix, FAQ) per key page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks (matrix interaction, add-ons, navigation) on mobile viewport

notes: Prioritize pricing matrix interaction and add-on calculation as high-risk areas. Ensure all steps are within the max step limit (80) by focusing on critical checks first.

prescan_summary.title: Lattice DB — Analytics database
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: Lattice DB Platform Pricing Docs Customers Sign in Book demo The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly. Lattice DB combines a Postgres-compatible API with a Parquet-backed analytical engine. Mix transactional and analytical workloads without a separate warehouse. SELECT region, sum(revenue) AS r FROM orders JOIN customers USING (customer_id) WHERE order_date >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY region ORDER BY r DESC; Postgres wire Drop in any pg client. We speak the protocol. Columnar under the hood Vectorized execution. Late materialization. Zone maps. Pay for the cell you live in Pricing on team size × data size. No phantom add-ons. See pricing Local demo for UXBench. Fictional product, not a real company.
headings: The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly.
Pay for the cell you live in
